description: Create Bun-based API backend server at apps/server/ that proxies all vidapi.ru requests with in-memory caching, CORS, error handling, and request logging. Update frontend API client to point to the backend. Update deployment configs for the new architecture.
steps: Create apps/server/ directory structure with package.json (name: hijistream-server, scripts: dev with bun --watch src/index.js, start with bun src/index.js). Use Bun as the runtime.

Create apps/server/src/index.js - Bun.serve HTTP server on port 3001 (or PORT env). Implement route matching for: GET /api/movies/latest/page-:page.json, GET /api/movies/trending/page-:page.json, GET /api/movies/top-rated/page-:page.json, GET /api/movies/upcoming/page-:page.json, GET /api/tv/latest/page-:page.json, GET /api/tv/trending/page-:page.json, GET /api/tv/top-rated/page-:page.json, GET /api/search?query=..., GET /api/movie/:id.json, GET /api/tv/:id.json, GET /health. Route matching should strip /api prefix and proxy to https://vidapi.ru/.
Implement in-memory cache (Map-based) with TTL: 24h for list endpoints, 7d for detail endpoints, 1h for search. Add request logging (method, path, status, cache hit/miss, response time).
Add CORS headers (Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Allow-Methods: GET, OPTIONS, Allow-Headers: Content-Type). Handle OPTIONS preflight.
Add error handling: try/catch around upstream fetch, return appropriate status codes (502 for upstream failure, 404 for unknown routes, 500 for internal errors). Return JSON error responses.
Create apps/server/Dockerfile - FROM oven/bun:latest, WORKDIR /app, COPY package.json bun.lock, RUN bun install --production, COPY src/, EXPOSE 3001, CMD bun src/index.js.
Update apps/web/src/utils/api.js - Change BASE_URL to: import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL || 'http://localhost:3001/api'. Remove the /api prefix since backend already has it in the path.
Update apps/web/vite.config.js - Remove the server.proxy block (backend handles CORS directly, no need for Vite proxy).

Update apps/web/vercel.json - Change the API rewrite destination to point to backend URL placeholder (keep as environment variable pattern): { source: '/api/:path*', destination: 'https://your-backend.onrender.com/api/:path*' }. Keep the SPA fallback rewrite.

Update render.yaml at project root - Add a second service for the backend: type web, name hijistream-api, runtime docker, dockerfilePath apps/server/Dockerfile, envVars PORT 3001. Update the web static service to add env var VITE_API_URL pointing to the backend service.
Update apps/web/index.html Content-Security-Policy - add connect-src to include the backend URL pattern (localhost:3001 for dev). Keep vidapi.ru for any image URLs that come through.
Keep apps/web/functions/api/[[path]].js (Cloudflare proxy) as-is - it serves as a serverless alternative when users deploy only to Cloudflare Pages without the backend.
Create a root package.json for the monorepo with workspaces: ['apps/*'] and scripts: dev:web, dev:server, dev (runs both), build:web, start:server.
acceptance_criteria: apps/server/src/index.js starts with `bun run start` and responds to GET /health with 200 OK
All API endpoints proxy correctly to vidapi.ru and return valid JSON
Cache returns cached data on second request within TTL
CORS headers present on all responses
Frontend api.js uses VITE_API_URL env var instead of hardcoded /api path
Vite config no longer has proxy configuration
Root package.json exists with monorepo workspace scripts
render.yaml includes both web and server services
verification: Run `bun run start` in apps/server/ and verify /health returns 200
Run `bun run lint` in apps/web/ - 0 errors
Run `bun run typecheck` in apps/web/ - 0 errors
Run `bun run build` in apps/web/ - success
findings: Added vite/client to jsconfig.json types array to resolve import.meta.env typecheck error. Root .gitignore created to exclude node_modules/ and dist/ at monorepo level. Root bun.lock generated by workspace resolution - committed as it locks dependency versions. Server has no runtime dependencies so bun install just resolves workspace. All verification passed: server starts on port 3001, lint 0 errors, typecheck 0 errors, build succeeds.
